notes: The Command Center cooking panel is now kitchen-readable: ingredient and step text is about a third bigger, with larger titles, tags, and touch targets. Steps are interactive - tap one to check it off and the next step highlights so you never lose your place. Any time mentioned in a step ('bake 25 minutes', '2-3 min per side') is now a tappable timer chip: tap it and a countdown pill appears at the bottom of the screen. When a timer finishes, the pill pulses red and the Alexas announce it through the same announce service the departure countdowns use (kiosk only - phones just get the on-screen alarm and a beep). Tap a running pill to cancel it, or a ringing one to dismiss it.
